findings.what: If this test uses insta (as its name suggests), moving it from `protocol::request::tests` to `protocol::request::verbs::tests` breaks it. insta derives both the snapshot file name (`..__protocol__request__verbs__tests__...`) and its directory (`src/protocol/request/snapshots/` instead of `src/protocol/snapshots/`) from the module path and source file location. This commit does not rename any `.snap` files, so the existing wire snapshots will not be found and the test will fail in CI, or write fresh `.snap.new` files locally.
